name: resumelingo-app
description: ResumeLingo — full-stack scaffold. client/ (React+Vite) pairs with either server/ (Node+Express+SQLite, local dev) or worker/ (Cloudflare Workers+Hono+D1, production on Cloudflare).

scripts.build:shared: npm install --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix shared
scripts.install:all: npm run build:shared && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.install:worker: npm run build:shared && npm install --prefix worker && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --prefix worker
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run build --prefix client && npm run deploy --prefix worker
